build.description: Tauri desktop build. The ^build dependency reaches @repo/web through the workspace devDependency in package.json (issue #516), so Turbo builds the web bundle that src-tauri/tauri.conf.json frontendDist points at before `tauri build` runs; knip ignores that devDependency because no TypeScript imports it. Rust artifacts under the repo-root .tauri-target (src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml) are managed by Cargo's own incremental cache and are intentionally not declared as Turbo outputs, so this task opts out of Turbo caching to avoid restoring a stale or absent binary on a cache hit.
